column2: Retain Simon hearing of Tryphon’s large force and purpose to enter/crush Judah. The stated intention remains distinct from completed conquest.
Retain trembling and terror, Simon’s ascent to Jerusalem and gathering the people. Both fear descriptions remain before his encouragement.
Retain emphatic you yourselves, Simon/brothers/father’s house, laws/holy places and witnessed battles/hardships. The collective family effort is not reduced to Simon alone.
Retain all brothers perished and I alone left as Simon’s speech. Do not silently reconcile this with Jonathan appearing alive as captive in verse 12.
column3: How should this speech’s death claim relate to the prior report and later narrated killing? The selected sequence remains intact pending literary/historical review.

column2: Retain Far be it without inserting God, sparing life in distress and no superiority to brothers. Life is the contextual sense of soul in this pledged risk.
Retain vengeance for nation/holy places/wives/children and all nations’ hatred. The implacable purpose belongs to the speech and is not softened into general protection alone.
Retain the people’s spirit rekindled on hearing. The fire metaphor remains without turning spirit into an explicitly named divine person.
Retain the loud response and leadership in place of Judas and Jonathan your brother. The singular brother apposition is not automatically pluralized to harmonize the family list.
Retain fight our war and commitment to do everything told. Ordinary you addresses a human leader.
Retain all warriors, haste to finish Jerusalem walls and surrounding fortification. Completion is the aim of the haste, not an invented construction timetable.
Retain Jonathan son of Absalom, sufficient force, Joppa, expulsion and residence. This Jonathan is distinct from Simon’s captive brother; the final he contextually refers to the dispatched commander.
Retain Tryphon’s departure from Ptolemais with a large force and Jonathan under guard. The captive’s presence must not be removed to match earlier death reports.
Retain Simon’s Adida camp facing the plain. The inflected place form is not treated as a second unrelated location.
Retain Tryphon learning of Simon’s succession and impending battle, followed by envoys. Both reported circumstances motivate the negotiation.
Retain the claimed royal debt arising from Jonathan’s offices. This is Tryphon’s explanation, not a verified debt certified by the translator.
Retain one hundred silver talents, two sons as hostages and the promised release to prevent revolt. Both payment and personal sureties remain.
Retain Simon’s awareness of deceit, fetching money/children and concern about popular hostility. The historical present sends is naturally narrated in past English without changing sequence.
Retain the awkward plural they said followed by first-person I did not send and his perishing. Do not silently turn I into he to smooth the speech perspective.
column3: Does this represent Simon voicing the accusation against himself, a reported-speech shift or another construction? The inherited wording remains explicitly provisional.

column2: Retain children and hundred talents sent, Tryphon’s deceit and refusal to release Jonathan. Tryphon is a contextual named subject for the source’s shifted singular verb.
Retain invasion intent, circuit by Adora and Simon’s corresponding movement everywhere Tryphon went. The route is not reconstructed beyond the named road.
Retain citadel envoys urgently requesting wilderness approach and food. Their request is not treated as already supplied provisions.
Retain all cavalry readied, heavy snow that night, failure to come because of snow and movement to Gilead. The environmental cause is explicit and not replaced by a tactical motive.
Retain approaching Bascama, Jonathan killed and buried there. The burial passive does not name a separate burial party; Jonathan is supplied to clarify the repeated pronouns.
Retain Tryphon turning away to his own land. No further destination is inserted.
Retain Simon retrieving Jonathan’s bones and burial at ancestral Modein. The bones term is not generalized to an unqualified living body or an invented interval after death.
Retain all Israel’s great lament and many days of mourning. The paired grief expressions remain.
Retain the father/brothers’ tomb, visible height and dressed stone front/back. The construction description does not specify a complete architectural plan.
Retain seven pyramids opposite one another and the named father, mother and four brothers. The number seven is not reduced to the six named relatives, nor is a seventh recipient inserted.
column3: Does one structure anticipate Simon’s own burial or serve another function? The source does not state this, so it remains open.

column2: Retain elaborate structures, great columns, full armour and engraved ships visible to sea travelers. The memorial’s precise visual arrangement remains provisional rather than reconstructed.
Retain the Modein tomb existing to this day. This day is the narrator’s standpoint, not a claim of modern survival.
Retain deceit toward young King Antiochus and his killing. The explicit victim is distinct from the older kings of that name.
Retain replacement kingship, Asia’s diadem and a great blow upon the land. The destructive political result is not reduced to neutral succession.
Retain Judean forts, high towers, great walls, gates/bars and food stores. The fortification and provisioning actions remain distinct.
Retain envoys to Demetrius for remission and the characterization of all Tryphon’s acts as plunder. Remission’s exact fiscal scope remains contextual.
Retain the reply and letter introduction. The repeated sending/replying/writing functions are naturally condensed without deleting a distinct document.
Retain Simon high priest and Friend of kings, elders and nation. The plural kings remains, and the court title is not treated as a literal personal friendship with every king.
Retain golden crown, palm branch, great peace and orders to officials for remissions. The palm object’s material is not automatically gold merely because the preceding crown is golden.
column3: What kind of palm-shaped gift does the term denote here? The inherited palm branch remains provisional.

column2: Retain established terms standing and ownership of constructed forts. The present stands preserves the firmness of the royal declaration.
Retain offences of ignorance and sins through today, owed crown payment and cessation of other Jerusalem levies. The political pardon terms are not recast as divine absolution.
Retain suitable people enrolled among the royal circle and peace between parties. No specific rank is supplied for those around us.
Retain year 170 and removal of the nations’ yoke from Israel. The passive does not expressly name an additional liberating agent.
Retain first-year dating in documents/contracts and Simon’s great high-priest, general and leader titles. The dating formula does not require inserting a new royal title.
Retain Gazara, surrounding camps, siege tower, one struck tower and capture. The siege machine and city tower are distinct objects.
Retain men leaping from the siege tower into the city and great commotion. The motion is not changed into an unstated breach by underground means.
Retain inhabitants with wives/children on the wall, torn clothes and loud plea for Simon’s right hand. This is human negotiation, not direct prayer to God.
Retain the plea according to your mercy rather than their wickedness. Your is ordinary address to Simon even though the language resembles a prayer formula.
Retain coming to terms, no further fighting, expulsion, cleansing idol houses and entry with hymns/blessing. Settlement does not erase the narrated displacement.
column3: The agreement/relenting verb may also carry emotional force; the inherited coming to terms remains provisional, without claiming a separate written treaty.

column2: Retain every uncleanness removed, law-observing settlers, further fortification and Simon’s own dwelling. The new settlement is not merged with the expelled population.
Retain restricted movement/trade, severe hunger and many famine deaths in the citadel. The siege’s effects remain explicit rather than merely a voluntary surrender.

Propose They cried to Simon for his right hand in pledge for the ambiguous to receive a pledge of peace. This clarifies the petitioners’ receipt and retains the source’s bodily treaty idiom. Keep expulsion and cleansing afterward.
Retain day twenty-three, second month, year 171, praise/palms and the full instrument/hymn/song list. The great enemy crushed from Israel remains the celebration’s stated reason.
Retain annual joyful observance, further fortification of the temple mount beside the citadel and residence with companions. The two adjacent sites are not silently identified as one structure.
Retain John as Simon’s grown son, command of all forces and Gazara residence. The final subject is contextually John, not a new named commander.
